svg.title: RuView · WiFi becomes spatial awareness.
svg.desc: RuView-focused animation showing WiFi sensors, spatial perception, Ruflo coordination and an illustrative ruOS sensing workspace. Room occupancy and actions are synthetic examples, not live measurements.

g.text: Your room is already sending signals.
From radio signals to useful actions.
RuView senses. Ruflo coordinates. ruOS runs the workflow.
A sensing workspace, powered by RuView.
Example: room activity → rule check → action review.
